name: sqlfrontend-csproj-publish-subset
body: SqlFrontend.csproj carries only the PublishSingleFile, SelfContained and IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract publish settings of src/csharplib/CsharpFrontend.csproj; it omits PublishReadyToRun, ImplicitUsings, Nullable and the EmbedCarriedRuntimeReferences target. Add ImplicitUsings/Nullable when Program.cs or a later source file relies on them, and PublishReadyToRun when the published sqlfrontend should match the C# frontend's startup profile.
